benchmark.coordinate_sampling: VectorBlock coordinates 0..80 and Route coordinates 0..20 (canonical indices 16384..16404); not 100 consecutive canonical coordinates; exact row/cursor bindings required from reviewed runner
benchmark.dtype: i32 geometric vectors and gate storage, u32 routes/indices, u64 losses/counters
benchmark.synchronization: Device::synchronize before clock start and after carry/propose/observation

planned_training.cost_formula: sum over arms/seeds of (16384 * vector_batch_seconds + 20 * route_batch_seconds + accepted_apply_seconds + 5 * full_dev_seconds + qualifying_fresh_seconds + initialization_checkpoint_archive_retry_seconds) / 3600 * booked_GPU_hourly_rate
planned_training.rate_selection: measure both checkpoint0 and Q4 for each objective; disclose scenario and occupancy, do not substitute historical K8 rate
